title: Coordinate bounds imply state bounds
statement: Let $B$ be a natural number and let $\mathrm{st}$ be a state record with fifteen natural-number coordinates, whose coordinate vector lists those coordinates in order. If every entry of this vector is at most $B$, then each of the fifteen coordinates of $\mathrm{st}$ is at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: Every entry of the coordinate vector of st is at most B
